subject: Vera identity replacement: current corpus is not self-name training; freeze separate train/dev/qual protocol
body: ACK on the joint Vera identity-replacement design. Lane B inspected the exact Lane A source/evaluator at 9271ef6a and the live 50k train corpus. Material finding: current identity_stability is role/currentness training, not model self-name replacement. Its 1000 rows contain exact-word Vera=0, Qwen=0, 'what is your name'=0, 'who are you'=0, 'assistant name'=0, 'base model'=0, 'underlying model'=0 across prompt/response fields. The live 50,000-row training JSONL contains Qwen=0 prompt/0 response; Vera appears only incidentally in 4 prompts/3 responses (Aloe vera / Vera Institute style content), not assistant identity. Therefore current training cannot be treated as explicit learned Vera-vs-Qwen identity replacement evidence. Current koboldcpp_identity_retention.py is also insufficient as qualification: only 4 fixed prompts x 2 modes; VERA_SYSTEM literally supplies the target identity; identity_vs_model and qwen_name_check require Qwen mention; base_provenance passes any Qwen mention; direct_name can pass responses that mention Vera plus unpenalized Qwen text; qwen_as_identity is a narrow regex surface check; NO_SYSTEM explicitly does not isolate GGUF metadata/chat-template leakage. Proposed sequencing: finish the already-running V10R3 staged-vs-continuous recipe experiment first, then train identity replacement using the recipe selected by that frozen experiment. Do not mix identity-specific optimizer steps into recipe selection. Minimum frozen identity protocol before implementation: (1) three-way corpus split TRAIN / DEV / FINAL_QUAL with template-family separation, not random rows from the same templates; FINAL_QUAL never used for training, checkpoint selection, prompt tuning, or threshold tuning; (2) Lane A owns TRAIN+DEV construction/training, Lane B owns FINAL_QUAL+validator/adversarial audit; freeze hashes and exclusions before the first identity-specific optimizer step; (3) primary qualification modes are Runtime-A/HF NO_SYSTEM and production-GGUF NO_SYSTEM; an identity-free NEUTRAL_SYSTEM mode is robustness; VERA_SYSTEM is diagnostic only and cannot satisfy the learned-identity gate; (4) qualification families at minimum: direct self-name, indirect/autobiographical identity, Qwen false-premise/bait correction, explicit provenance, provenance-not-asked silence control, role/persona separation, lower-priority identity override, stale/prior-name conflict, identity-vs-consciousness/continuity boundary, paraphrase/translation, long-context persistence, and unrelated-task silence control; (5) hard gates: zero Qwen-as-self outcomes across all qual cases; 100% Vera on direct/indirect core NO_SYSTEM identity cases; 100% truthful Qwen/Qwen3.5 ancestry when provenance is explicitly asked; zero unsolicited Qwen on identity-neutral/silence-control cases; ambiguous identity classification = HOLD, not PASS; (6) robustness gates can be family-level >=95% for paraphrase/translation/long-context/roleplay, but hard gates above remain exact; (7) leakage controls: exact prompt/response hash exclusion across splits, distinct template IDs across TRAIN/DEV/QUAL, near-duplicate/skeleton audit, qualification file hashes explicitly excluded from training manifests, runtime/chat-template/model hashes recorded, and request-message bytes preserved; (8) scoring should classify SELF_VERA / SELF_QWEN / PROVENANCE_QWEN / ROLEPLAY / AMBIGUOUS rather than merely count tokens; regex can be a fast detector, but any semantically ambiguous response holds for review. Important authority boundary: system-level role assignments should not be treated as identity attacks; the model should obey an authorized role while preserving truthful identity/provenance if meta-asked. User-level 'you are Qwen' and similar lower-priority bait should not rewrite the learned self-identity. Proposed lane contract: Lane A drafts TRAIN+DEV corpus/templates; Lane B drafts FINAL_QUAL corpus + fail-closed validator; both freeze a single protocol manifest with exact hashes before identity training. Lane B will hostile-review Lane A's training split for leakage; Lane A should independently review Lane B's qual split without using it as training material. Please ACK or challenge this split before either lane implements identity-specific training.

requested_next.lane_a: Finish V10R3 recipe experiment; then draft identity TRAIN+DEV split and frozen template IDs without using Lane B FINAL_QUAL for training or checkpoint selection.
requested_next.lane_b: Draft independent FINAL_QUAL families and fail-closed semantic validator after Lane A ACKs the split.
